landing.description: Sign in to get structured critique of your work, palette and value studies, and a plan for your next session.
landing.errorInvalid: Those credentials weren't recognized. Please try again.

home.title: Studio
home.description: Your workspace. Upload a piece to begin a critique, or start a session plan.

intake.title: Start a project
intake.description: Upload the reference photograph you are working from, and tell us what you are trying to make. Nothing here is generated — the plan is built around the work you do.
intake.fileHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP · up to {limitMb} MB · at least {minPx} px on the long edge.

dropZone.prompt: Drag a photograph here, or click to choose one
dropZone.replacePrompt: Drag another photograph here, or click to replace this one
dropZone.previewAlt: Preview of the chosen reference photograph

intake.timeHint: In minutes. A three-hour session is 180.
intake.supportHint: Optional. The physical size of the paper, panel or canvas you are working on — leave it blank if you have not decided.
intake.goalHint: Optional. Free text, in your own words — for example, “likeness matters more than finish”. It is stored and screened as text, never followed as an instruction.

errors.missingFile: Choose a reference photograph to work from.
errors.tooLarge: That photograph is over {limitMb} MB. Export it at a smaller size and try again.
errors.unsupportedType: That file is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP. Convert it and try again.
errors.undecodable: That file could not be read as an image. It may be incomplete — try exporting it again.
errors.belowMinDimension: That photograph is too small to measure. The long edge needs to be at least {minPx} px.
errors.invalidIntent: Something in the project details was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
errors.missingMedium: Choose the medium you are working in.
errors.invalidTime: Enter how many minutes you have, as a whole number above zero.
errors.invalidSupport: Enter both the width and the height as numbers above zero, or leave the support size blank.
errors.goalTooLong: That is longer than the field takes. Shorten it and try again.
errors.duplicate: You have already uploaded this exact photograph.
errors.createdUnreadable: Your photograph was uploaded, but the reply could not be read, so the project could not be opened. The project may already exist — reload before uploading it again.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Sign in again, then start the project.
errors.network: The upload did not reach us. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unavailable: The upload could not be completed just now. Try again in a moment.

project.planPending: The working plan is not built yet. Routing comes first; the reference assessment, the plates and the plan follow in later work.
project.title: Your project
project.photoAlt: The reference photograph for this project
project.noOriginal: This project has no reference photograph yet.
project.unavailable: This project could not be loaded right now. Try again in a moment.

run.title: Analysis
run.disconnectedHint: The analysis may still be running. Reload the page to pick it up again.
run.startFailed: The analysis could not be started.
run.startFailedTitle: The analysis could not be started
run.startFailedHint: The analysis service is not available right now. Try again in a moment.

routing.title: What the Studio Director chose
routing.directorsWords: The reasons above are the Studio Director's own words, and are shown in English.

failure.budget_exceeded: This project has used its analysis budget.
failure.deadline_exceeded: The analysis took too long and was stopped.
failure.guard_stopped: The analysis was stopped by one of its safety limits.
failure.project_not_found: This project could not be found.
failure.project_not_ready: This project needs a reference photograph and its intake details before it can be analysed.
failure.photograph_unavailable: The reference photograph could not be read for analysis.
failure.credential_rejected: Your session expired during the analysis. Sign in again and retry.
failure.data_service_refused: The data service refused a request during the analysis.
failure.routing_failed: The Studio Director could not decide which studies to run.
failure.interrupted: The analysis service stopped before the analysis finished.
failure.internal_error: Something went wrong inside the analysis service.
failure.invalid_stream: The analysis service sent an update that could not be read.

project.sessionExpired: Your session has expired, so this project cannot be read.

metadata.title: Artist Studio — Art Loupe
metadata.description: Artist-facing critique and studio-planning companion: structured formal analysis grounded in public-domain collections, never generated imagery.

inspiration.title: Get inspired
inspiration.description: Find photographs and paintings to inspire your next idea. Search one collection at a time.
inspiration.datesHint: Enter both years, earliest first, or leave both blank. Use negative years for BCE.
inspiration.filterLoaded: Filter loaded results by title or creator
inspiration.creator: Creator A–Z
inspiration.start: Enter keywords, or an artist for the Met, to begin. Terms shorter than three letters search when you press Search.
inspiration.count: {count, plural, =0 {No images shown} one {# image shown} other {# images shown}}
inspiration.earlierTerm: These results are for “{previous}”. Press Search to search for “{next}”.
inspiration.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Sign in again to search.
inspiration.rateLimited: You are searching faster than this page allows. Wait a few seconds, then try again.
inspiration.unavailable: This collection is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
inspiration.retained: Your loaded images are still available below.
inspiration.stale: Showing cached results because the collection is unavailable. These may be up to seven days old.
inspiration.partial: Some artwork details could not be loaded. You can retry the search.
inspiration.empty: No displayable images found in this batch. Try different filters or load another batch if available.
inspiration.noLocalMatches: No loaded images match your filter. Clear the filter to see them again.
inspiration.loadedHint: Filtering and sorting apply to loaded images only. Each Met batch excludes works without an eligible painting image.

learning.title: Learn about art
learning.description: Ask about drawing, painting, or art history. Answers draw on three selected books and show the passages they use.
learning.privacy: This conversation stays in this tab. Your question and recent turns are sent to the answer provider; vector search also sends your question to the embedding provider. Closing or reloading clears the conversation.
learning.exampleValue: What is the difference between value and color?
learning.exampleSpace: How does negative space help a composition?
learning.historical: This is a historical text. Materials advice may be outdated.
learning.question: Your question
learning.hint: Ask a specific question. If the books do not provide enough evidence, the assistant will say so.
learning.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Sign in again to ask a question.
learning.rateLimited: Please wait a moment before asking another question.
learning.unavailable: Learning is temporarily unavailable. Your question is still here; please try again.
learning.tokenLimit: This question and its context exceed the learning limit. Clear the conversation or ask a shorter question.
